name: +1 Speed Per Click
desc:
⚡ Welcome to +1 Speed Per Click ⚡

How to play: :
👆 Click to build up your speed
🏆 Conquer challenging obstacle stages
💨 Run across the map to grow even faster
⚡ Unlock strong multipliers and rise to the top as the FASTEST PLAYER! 
-- 
👍 Show your support by liking the game!
👥 Join the group to earn rewards and stay updated!

This game is heavily inspired and wouldn't have been possible by +1 Speed Per Step. Huge credits to @Christophrblx!
